slides.title:
Rest your legs with Hybi
at Hybrid Physio!

caption:
Nurse, chef, teacher, tradie? If you're on your feet all shift, your calves are working overtime.

Hours of standing leave many people with tight calves, aching arches and heavy legs. Remedial massage to the feet and calves can ease that feeling and help you move more comfortably. It works well alongside movement, not instead of it.

Hybi's after-shift reset: roll each sole over a ball for a minute, do 10 slow calf raises, stretch your calves on breaks and wear cushioned, supportive shoes.

One calf that's swollen, hot, red or painful needs urgent medical attention, especially after a long flight. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can tailor a session to your legs. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
